questions.question:

B. When she was only 19, she became the first black female assistant to Nashville’s evening news anchor.

C. But Oprah had a very difficult and traumatic childhood.

D. In 1986, Oprah became the television presenter of her own talk show called ‘The Oprah Winfrey Show’.
questions.solution:

• The first sentence of a paragraph is usually independent and introduces a topic. The second one provides more information about it. 
 
• Here, only A is independent and introduces an American celebrity Oprah Winfrey as the subject of the passage under discussion.
 
• So, A becomes the first sentence of the passage. 
 
• The only option that shows A as the first sentence is option 4.
 
• As per option 4, the full sequence is : ABDC.
 
 
• 
 
**A.** Oprah Winfrey is one of the richest and most powerful American women, loved and admired by everyone.

 
 
• 
 
**B. **When she was only 19, she became the first black female assistant to Nashville’s evening news anchor.

 
 
• 
 
**D.** In 1986, Oprah became the television presenter of her own talk show called ‘The Oprah Winfrey Show’.

 
 
• 
 
**C.** But Oprah had a very difficult and traumatic childhood.

 
 
 
 
• 
 
This sequence is logically correct, making option 4 the correct answer.

questions.question:
**Select the correct passive form of the given sentence.**

She has put fresh flowers in the flower vase.

options.text: Fresh flowers are put in the flower vase.
Fresh flowers have been put by her in the flower vase.
Fresh flowers are being put in the flower vase.
Fresh flowers has been put in the flower vase.

questions.solution:

• It has the following sentence pattern - **Subject **(she) + **has + past participle** (put) + **object** (fresh flowers) + **adjunct** (in the flower vase). 
 
• To change to passive form, we need to use the following sentence pattern - **Original object + has been + past participle + by original subject ****+** adjunct
 
• It should be noted that the **original subject** of the active voice sentence is the **pronoun she.**
 
• In passive voice this changes to her. 
 
• Following the above sentence pattern we get the following sentence - Fresh flowers have been put by her in the flower vase.
 
• This makes option 2 the correct answer.

questions.question:
Which two signs and two numbers should be interchanged to make the given equation correct?

questions.solution:
According to the BODMAS rule:

**Option 1 :** × and +, 12 and 4

Given:

12 × 5 + 7 ÷ 4 – 6 = 25

After interchange the signs;

4 + 5 × 7 ÷ 12 – 6 = 25

By BODMAS rule

4 + 5 × 0.584 – 6 = 25

4 + 2.92 – 6 = 25

6.92 – 6 = 25

0.92 = 25** (LHS ≠ RHS)**

**Option 2 : **× and ÷, 7 and 6

**Given:**

12 × 5 + 7 ÷ 4 – 6 = 25

After interchange the signs;

12 ÷ 5 + 6 × 4 – 7 = 25

By BODMAS rule

2.4 + 6 × 4 – 7 = 25

2.4 + 24 – 7 = 25

26.4 – 7 = 25

19.4 = 25** (LHS ≠ RHS)**

**Option 3 :** × and −, 6 and 5

Given:

12 × 5 + 7 ÷ 4 – 6 = 25

After interchange the signs;

12 - 5 + 7 ÷ 4 × 6 = 25

By BODMAS rule

12 - 6 + 1.75 × 5 = 25

12 - 6 + 8.75 = 25

20.75 - 6 = 25

14.75 = 25** (LHS ≠ RHS)**

**Option 4 :** ÷ and −, 4 and 12

**Given:**

**12 × 5 + 7 ÷ 4 – 6 = 25**

**After interchange the signs;**

**4 × 5 + 7 - 12 ÷ 6 = 25**

**By BODMAS rule**

**4 × 5 + 7 - 2 = 25**

**20 + 7 - 2 = 25**

**27 - 2 = 25**

**25 = 25 (LHS = RHS)**

Hence, the answer is **“****÷ and −, 4 and 12****”.**

questions.question: The average of the squares of four consecutive odd natural numbers is 201. The average of 7 times of the largest number and 3 times of the smallest number is:
questions.solution:
**Given**

Average of the squares of four consecutive odd natural numbers = 201

**concept**

Average = Sum of all observation/Number of observation

(a + b)² = a² + b² + 2ab

**Explanation**

Let the four odd consecutive natural numbers are x, (x + 2), (x + 4) and (x + 6)

[(x)² + (x + 2)² + (x + 4)² + (x + 6)²]/4 = 201

⇒ [x² + x² + 4 + 4x + x² + 16 + 8x + x² + 36 + 12x]/4 = 201

⇒ [4x² + 24x + 56]/4 = 201

⇒ x² + 6x + 14 = 201

⇒ x² + 6x - 187 = 0

⇒ x² + 17x - 11x - 187 = 0

⇒ x(x + 17) - 11(x + 17) = 0

⇒ (x - 11) (x + 17) = 0

⇒ x = 11 and x = - 17

Largest number is 17 i.e.(11 + 6)

7 times of largest number = 17 × 7

⇒ 119

Smallest number = 11

Three times of smallest number = 33

Required average = (119 + 33)/2

⇒ 152/2

⇒ 76

**∴ The average of 7 times of the largest number and 3 times of the smallest number is 76.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Rani Rampal is an Indian field hockey player from Haryana.
 
• She is currently the Captain of the Indian Women's Hockey Team.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Indian women’s Hockey team captain Rani Rampal is the World Games Athlete of the Year 2019, thus becoming the first-ever hockey player to win the prestigious World Games Athlete of the Year Award.
 
• In 2020 the Government of India honored her with the Padma Shri.
 
• Rani played in the Champion's Challenge Tournament held in Kazan, Russia in June 2009 and powered India to a win by scoring 4 goals in the finals.
 
• At the age of 15, she was the youngest player in the national team which participated in the 2010 World Cup.
